races.name: Racing TV Club Day Here Today Handicap

runners_data.name: Fareenar
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from 195-day break but showed promise in C&D third on good ground last season
runners_data.comment: Third in C&D novice last October when last seen and begins handicap life on a fair mark
runners_data.spotlight: Steady improvement across her three 2yo starts, all here, finishing third in a C&D novice (good) last October when last seen; begins handicap life on a fair mark and in a first-time tongue-tie; not discounted.

runners_data.name: Mohaasset
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with modest form but new stable connection after being sold, quick return from new yard
runners_data.comment: Failed to build on initial 2yo promise; bred to be suited by new trip on h'cap/yard debut
runners_data.spotlight: Fairly encouraging debut run at Newbury (5f, good) last April; two lesser runs followed (6f/7f, good/soft) and she was sold out of Darryll Holland's yard for 1,000gns last September; however, she's bred to be suited by the step up in trip on handicap/stable debut and is not ruled out.

runners_data.name: Kameko Fever
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who went close at Newcastle in March but disappointed subsequently, 18 days since last run
runners_data.comment: Went close on AW in March but soundly beaten on subsequent turf debut at Musselburgh
runners_data.spotlight: Went close at Newcastle (1m, AW) in March on second handicap start and he's of interest on that form, but he was then a soundly beaten fourth of ten at Musselburgh (1m, good) this month on his first run on turf; now 0-6.

runners_data.name: Ice Cube
runners_data.note: Likely pace-setter gelded since last run, drops hood that aided previous improvement at Newmarket
runners_data.comment: Useful pedigree and connections had a 3yo handicap newcomer win easily over C&D last week
runners_data.spotlight: Improved upon first two runs when seventh of eight in warm maiden at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) last September in a first-time hood (left off today); gelded since; pedigree provides hope that he will be better than his opening mark and connections had a 3yo handicap newcomer win over C&D last week.

runners_data.name: Rocklaw
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare who fades in finishes, recent Thirsk fourth suggests step forward but pace dependency remains
runners_data.comment: Steady pace appeared against her at Thirsk; goes handicapping and is open to improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Made debut in February and took a step forward when fourth of six at Thirsk (1m, good) three weeks ago on her third run, when the steady pace appeared to be against her; goes handicapping today and she's open to improvement.

runners_data.name: Karakula Dancer
runners_data.note: Strong AW performer but unproven on turf, hold-up style requires genuine pace to be effective

runners_data.name: Walk On Walk On
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from poor seasonal debut, inconsistent type with limited winning prospects
runners_data.comment: Made it 0-7 when well beaten at 28-1 on his recent stable and seasonal debut at Ripon
runners_data.spotlight: Displayed some ability last year but went 0-6 and he was well beaten at 28-1 on his recent stable and seasonal debut at Ripon.

runners_data.name: Ephron
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 202-day absence, expensive purchase suggests ability but needs major improvement
runners_data.comment: Down the field on his three 2yo starts; could be capable of better; watch the betting
runners_data.spotlight: Down the field on his three 2yo starts (7f/6f) and improvement is needed off his opening mark; however, he cost 52,000euros at the breeze-ups last May and could be capable of better; gelded since last time; watch the betting.

runners_data.name: Lope Y Linda
runners_data.note: Prominent type with poor 2022 record including nursery defeats, lowest OR runner returning after winter break
runners_data.comment: Ran six times last year and finished no better than fifth; improvement needed
runners_data.spotlight: Ran six times last year and finished no better than fifth, including in three nurseries in the autumn; improvement needed on reappearance.

races.paceDynamic: Ice Cube represents the sole confirmed front runner in this small field, with Mohaasset and Lope Y Linda likely to press from prominent positions early. The sustainable pace created by this limited early speed should allow Ice Cube to dictate terms without excessive pressure through the middle stages. With six of nine runners holding up tactics (Fareenar, Kameko Fever, Rocklaw, Karakula Dancer, Walk On Walk On, Ephron), the race sets up as a tactical affair where the front division can control proceedings. This pace dynamic strongly favours prominent racers and those able to track the pace, as the hold-up brigade will face a wall of horses in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Division Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Ice Cube sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Ice Cube to kick clear turning for home while Mohaasset can track and challenge. The hold-up horses struggle to make up ground in a slowly-run race with limited gaps.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Springs
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling and bunches the field approaching the turn
scenarios.body: The compressed field creates traffic problems but one hold-up horse finds a clear passage to exploit the sprint finish. Karakula Dancer's recent AW form suggests he can quicken when getting a true pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Mohaasset or Lope Y Linda force stronger early fractions than expected
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and plays into the hands of horses with stamina reserves at this mile trip. Fareenar's staying-on third at this course and distance comes into play.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Ice Cube gets headed early and no one wants the lead
scenarios.body: The lack of natural pace setters creates a stop-start race where any horse finding clear running can prevail. The tactical nature could suit an improver like Ephron despite his poor recent form.

watchPoints.text: Ice Cube's jumping and early position - if he misses the break or gets headed early, the pace scenario collapses completely
Karakula Dancer's turf adaptation - his strong AW form needs to translate to this surface for any chance
Fareenar's fitness after 195 days off - any signs of rustiness will compromise her staying-on style
Market support for Mohaasset and Ephron - both represent new connections and could indicate improvement
The pace through the first quarter-mile - if it's genuinely strong, it transforms the race for closers

races.name: Join Racing TV Restricted Novice Stakes (For horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Elias Escape
runners_data.comment: Half-brother to several winners; market check advised on debut but useful standard needed

runners_data.name: Pacific Glory
runners_data.comment: Trainer won this last year but this Masar gelding may need further than today's debut trip
runners_data.spotlight: 3,500gns foal; eighth foal; half-brother to five winners including Nairai (French 9.7f/1m4f), Fedya (French 1m3f) and Star's Of Pride (German 7.5f/1m); dam US 6f 2yo winner; trainer won this last year but this Masar gelding may need further than today's debut trip.

runners_data.name: Hungarian
runners_data.comment: Promise in defeat on all four starts last year; leading form claims on this reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Showed promise in defeat on all four starts last year, finishing fourth of 26 in a sales race at Newmarket (7f, good) in October when last seen; first-time cheekpieces replace the blinkers adopted last time; leading claims if at the top of his game on this reappearance.

runners_data.name: Whernside
runners_data.comment: Runner-up on AW this month on second start and he's open to further improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Left his sole 2yo run (1m, AW) well behind when runner-up at Newcastle (7f, AW) this month; open to further improvement for trainer who won this in 2024 and he's one to consider on his turf debut.

runners_data.name: Lucky Hero
runners_data.comment: 0-7 last year but in the first three on five occasions; has been gelded; possible player
runners_data.spotlight: Made it 0-7 when below par in Goodwood nursery last October when last seen; gelded since; however, he finished in the first three on five occasions last season and his trainer won this in 2022 and 2023; possible player.

races.name: Start Racing TV Free Trial Now Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Egotistical
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form on similar going but may lack the tactical speed to capitalize on this modest pace scenario

runners_data.name: Viviana
runners_data.note: Unraced unknown from struggling Johnston stable but McDonald booking suggests some ability hidden

runners_data.name: Confide In Me
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfectly suited to this race shape after impressive debut win, though step up in class is notable
runners_data.comment: Did well to win on this month's debut at Southwell and she's respected under a 7lb penalty
runners_data.spotlight: Unraced dam from a good Cheveley Park family but didn't make the track for them and bought for 2,500gns last December; 9-1 when winning on this month's debut at Southwell (7f, AW), doing well to come from further behind than the other principals in a slowly run race; respected under 7lb penalty.

runners_data.name: Highfield Jewel
runners_data.note: Limited ability shown in two winter starts and 98-day break makes her hard to recommend despite suitable running style
runners_data.comment: Showed some ability at Southwell this winter but not enough to suggest she's the one to be
runners_data.spotlight: Showed some ability at Southwell this winter on her first two starts (7f/6f, AW) but not enough to suggest she's the one to be on today.

runners_data.name: Why Because
runners_data.note: Prominent style fits the race flow but multiple stable changes and 180-day absence raise reliability questions
runners_data.comment: 0-4 for Harry Charlton but best form reads well in today's context; makes stable debut
runners_data.spotlight: 0-4 for Harry Charlton; changed hands twice since, for 6,000gns on December 1 and 1,000gns on December 11; her best form reads well in today's context and she's not ruled out on her stable debut.

runners_data.name: Maldevious
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who will get uncontested lead but eight-race losing streak suggests limited ability to capitalize
runners_data.comment: 0-8 but had an excuse last time, after good run previously, and she might not be far away
runners_data.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who was down the field at Musselburgh (7f, good) 18 days ago but that may have come too soon, just two days after her close fourth of 15 at Thirsk (6f, good); stays 7f and might not be far away.

runners_data.name: Prima Domina
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse suited to race shape but 159-day layoff and previous action problems create significant doubts
runners_data.comment: Displayed promise on the first of her two runs but others have more substance to claims
runners_data.spotlight: Kept on for second on debut at Newcastle (6f, AW) last October, beaten about 5l at 12-1, then reportedly lost her action when well beaten there (6f) at 25-1; she's unexposed and it's possible 7f will suit, but others have more substance to their claims.

races.paceDynamic: Maldevious will set the pace from flag to finish with minimal early pressure, creating a comfortable rhythm in the first half of this 6f contest. The prominent runners Egotistical and Why Because will track the leader but neither appears quick enough to apply serious early pressure. With only one confirmed front-runner and a small field, this sets up as a sustainable pace scenario where the tempo will only quicken in the final 2f. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and closers who can benefit from the modest early gallop and finish fastest when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Maldevious gets an easy lead and maintains kick
scenarios.body: The front-runner controls the race unchallenged and has enough left to resist late closers on this sharp 6f trip. Eight-time maiden Maldevious finally capitalizes on ideal tactical conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Closer Benefits Most
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays modest throughout
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get maximum benefit from the slow early gallop and unleash superior finishing speed in the final furlong. Confide In Me and Prima Domina are best positioned to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Egotistical or Why Because improve positions early
scenarios.body: A prominent runner moves closer to Maldevious approaching the turn and uses that forward position to strike in the final 1f. The pace becomes more honest but still allows tactical speed to dominate.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unknown Quantity Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Viviana shows significantly more than expected
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced Johnston runner displays hidden ability and benefits from both the race shape and professional jockey McDonald. Charlie Johnston's 3-from-34 recent record makes this low probability.

watchPoints.text: Maldevious must be watched for early pace judgment - if she goes too fast early she will capitulate in the final furlong
Confide In Me's position turning for home will be crucial given her hold-up style needs the race to develop properly
McDonald's tactics on unknown Viviana could reveal Johnston stable confidence or lack thereof
Why Because's early positioning will indicate if connections expect her to overcome the long absence
Egotistical's ability to get closer to the pace than usual may determine if she can exploit this tactical setup

runners_data.name: Beerwah
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner in good current form needing traffic to part, strip blinkers could aid concentration
runners_data.comment: Modest strike-rate but beaten just a neck on last Friday's reappearance at Doncaster
runners_data.spotlight: Just one win from his 17 starts but that came last September at Beverley and he was beaten just a neck on his reappearance at Doncaster (5f, good to firm) last Friday; there's every chance he'll be bang there once more.

runners_data.name: Kyber Crystal
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from long break with apprentice aboard, inconsistent but capable on her day
runners_data.comment: Inconsistent last year but won on reappearance last April so she's capable when fresh

runners_data.name: Soul Seeker
runners_data.note: Sole pace angle on basement mark, sharply regressive but unopposed early lead creates opportunity
runners_data.comment: On a basement mark but sharply regressive last year and well beaten on reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: He's on a basement mark but this 9yo was sharply regressive last season and well beaten on his reappearance at Catterick three weeks ago.

runners_data.name: Zuffolo
runners_data.note: Prominent style with 5lb claimer, may have needed recent reappearance run and trainer in good form
runners_data.comment: No return to form on recent reappearance but this two-time C&D winner is not written off
runners_data.spotlight: Last season ended with two disappointing runs and there was no return to form on his recent reappearance; however, he may have needed that latest outing and this two-time C&D winner is back down to last September's last winning mark; not written off.

runners_data.name: Sanbona
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 161-day absence, handy mark but needs to prove fitness first time back
runners_data.comment: Won last August/September but campaign concluded with two disappointing runs
runners_data.spotlight: 5f wins on AW/turf in August/September last year and he's on a handy mark on that form; however, his campaign concluded with two disappointing runs and he needs to get back on track on this reappearance outing.

runners_data.name: Solar Biricz

runners_data.comment: Well beaten on stable/seasonal debut but well treated and not a forlorn hope back at 5f
runners_data.spotlight: Patchy form across final few runs for Brian Ellison last season and well beaten on recent stable/seasonal debut at Thirsk (6f, good); however, he's 5lb lower than when winning at Doncaster (5f, good to form) last June and is not a forlorn hope back at 5f in a first-time visor.

runners_data.name: Desert Champion
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with fade-in-finish concern, long absence and poor recent course record
runners_data.comment: On a reduced mark but disappointing in the main in the second half of last year
runners_data.spotlight: On a reduced mark and he showed some spark last November; however, he was disappointing in the main in the second half of last year and finished down the field on his last two starts; returns with something to prove.

runners_data.name: Doralee
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in current form having won over course and distance, low weight and sharp recent run
runners_data.comment: Has won just once but that was over C&D; close third last Friday; could be firmly involved
runners_data.spotlight: Her 18 races have yielded just one win but that came over C&D (good to firm) last August; close third of 14 at Doncaster last Friday (5f, good to firm; one place behind Beerwah) and she may again be firmly involved.

races.paceDynamic: Soul Seeker will lead from the gate with no serious opposition for the early pace, creating a sustainable tempo that won't stress the front end. Miss Rainbow, Kyber Crystal, Zuffolo, Sanbona, Desert Champion and Doralee will cluster in prominent positions creating significant traffic problems turning for home. The lack of early pressure means Soul Seeker can dictate fractions, while the prominent congestion will cause interference and blocked runs for the hold-up horses like Mrs Trump, Beerwah and Solar Biricz. This race shape clearly favours front runners and early prominent racers who can secure clean racing room before the cavalry charge begins.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Soul Seeker gets an easy lead and the prominent pack doesn't apply early pressure
scenarios.body: Soul Seeker dictates comfortable fractions and kicks clear when the traffic jam develops behind. The lack of pace pressure allows the leader to save energy for a final effort while others are stuck in the pack.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pace Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Rainbow or Zuffolo press Soul Seeker early to force genuine fractions
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and creates opportunities for hold-up horses with clean runs. Traffic reduces as horses begin to string out from the stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Finale
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent sextet stays bunched turning for home with minimal early pace
scenarios.body: Multiple horses hit the front simultaneously in a scrambling finish where the best-positioned prominent runner prevails. Clean passages become crucial as interference is widespread.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the field comes home in a bunch sprint
scenarios.body: A patient hold-up horse with the best turn of foot capitalizes on the slow tempo. The race becomes purely about who has the strongest finishing kick.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Soul Seeker being allowed uncontested fractions - if unopposed early he becomes extremely dangerous despite poor recent form
Monitor the prominent pack of Miss Rainbow, Zuffolo, Sanbona and Desert Champion for early scrimmaging that could compromise their chances
Watch Mrs Trump and Beerwah for market confidence given their hold-up styles need the race to develop favorably
Check if Kyber Crystal shows early pace despite long absence - her reappearance record suggests she could be sharper than expected
Watch Solar Biricz for improved effort under new trainer after disappointing recent debut run

races.name: Racing TV Free Trial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Fierce Fortitude
runners_data.note: Natural leader who should contest early pace with Thunder Wonder, recent C&D form and 131lbs weight gives him edge over pace rival

runners_data.name: James McHenry
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with Cambridgeshire form who was denied clear run last time, should benefit from expected honest pace
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced since 2024 Cambridgeshire 2nd; positive performance at Musselburgh recently
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in the Cambridgeshire (1m1f) in September 2024 and he's raced just four times since; denied clear run when keeping on for fifth of 12 at Musselburgh (1m1f, good) recently and the return to 1m2f is worth a go; could have a part to play in first-time cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Urban Road

runners_data.name: Diderot
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who refused to race in February but showed better form when sixth here last Monday, needs strong pace
runners_data.comment: 0-7 on turf but not devoid of promise here last Monday and he's not ruled out each-way
runners_data.spotlight: Not the force of old on AW and he refused to race at Lingfield in February; made it 0-7 on turf when 5l sixth of nine here (1m, good to firm) last Monday but that wasn't devoid of promise as he was denied a clear run and kept on pretty nicely; he's not ruled out each-way back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Raulin
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with C&D win last May but disappointing on seasonal reappearance, capable if returning to form
runners_data.comment: Three wins last year, including C&D; could improve for recent comeback run; not ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Went up the weights having won three times last year, including C&D (good to firm) in May; unplaced on final start last term and same story on recent reappearance, but he may have needed that latest run and is not ruled out.

runners_data.name: Thunder Wonder
runners_data.note: Natural leader but poor recent form makes him vulnerable if pressed early by Fierce Fortitude

runners_data.name: Austrian Theory
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who didn't run badly on reappearance at Ripon, better days behind him but each-way claims
runners_data.comment: Didn't run badly at Ripon on reappearance and could improve for it; last winning mark
runners_data.spotlight: 0-10 last year but placed on final two runs of the season last autumn and he didn't run badly at Ripon a fortnight ago on his reappearance; his last win came off this mark and he could improve for that recent outing.

runners_data.name: Project Geofin
runners_data.note: Returning from 154-day layoff after being tailed off last time, good summer form but major fitness concerns
runners_data.comment: Good season in the main last year and his record when fresh in the spring is pretty decent
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off last November when last seen but enjoyed a good season in the main otherwise, winning two in a row in the summer and finishing second over C&D (good) on his penultimate start; his record when fresh in the spring is pretty decent and he's one to consider.

races.paceDynamic: Fierce Fortitude and Thunder Wonder will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners having the pace to dominate the opening exchanges. This dual-pronged pace attack should create an honest gallop over the extended 1m2f trip, preventing any tactical dawdling. The strong pace will stretch the field and expose those who need cover, while setting up the race for closers with the stamina to capitalize. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish strongly off the guaranteed pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If Fierce Fortitude and Thunder Wonder duel early and weaken
scenarios.body: The honest pace will perfectly set up the race for the strong contingent of hold-up performers who can time their challenges. James McHenry, Diderot, and Urban Road all possess the tactical speed to strike late when the pace-setters tire.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runner survives pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Fierce Fortitude kicks clear turning in while Thunder Wonder weakens
scenarios.body: Fierce Fortitude's recent C&D form and lighter weight could see him outlast his pace rival and hold off late challengers. His superior recent form gives him the edge over Thunder Wonder in any early battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Ammes gets the perfect trip tracking the pace-setters
scenarios.body: The prominent runner can benefit from the pace battle ahead while avoiding the worst of it, positioning perfectly to strike when the leaders weaken. Ammes has the class and tactical positioning to capitalize on a strong pace scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Thunder Wonder leads throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Thunder Wonder gets an uncontested lead with Fierce Fortitude settling behind
scenarios.body: Without genuine pace pressure, the leader could dictate terms and prove hard to peg back despite recent poor form. This would require Fierce Fortitude to drop back, which seems unlikely given his natural pace.

watchPoints.text: Thunder Wonder could get uncontested lead if Fierce Fortitude doesn't go forward early, completely changing race dynamics
James McHenry's draw and early positioning crucial given his hold-up style and need for clear running room
Urban Road's starting gates behavior critical as slow-away would negate any pace advantage in small field
Project Geofin's fitness after 154-day absence could see dramatic improvement or complete collapse
Diderot's willingness to race after February refusal at Lingfield needs monitoring in preliminaries

runners_data.name: Fairydale
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 215-day layoff with stamina-laden pedigree suggesting this trip extension could unlock improvement despite lengthy absence.
runners_data.comment: Only fifth in her two nurseries but by Waldgeist and could appreciate this longer trip
runners_data.spotlight: Finished held in fifth last September in her two nurseries (8.4f/1m); however, she showed signs of promise previously and, being by Waldgeist, the step up in trip may well prove to be a positive move on her reappearance, for which she wears first-time cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Red Rifle
runners_data.note: Another hold-up performer absent for 203 days but trainer Grant Tuer's 3/11 record suggests selective placement of this lightly-raced gelding.
runners_data.comment: His nursery debut defeat doesn't tell the full story; reappears with trainer in fine form
runners_data.spotlight: Soundly beaten sixth of eight on nursery debut at Newcastle (1m, AW) last October but that doesn't tell the full story as he came home first of the three that raced on the near side; reappears with trainer in fine form and it will be no surprise to see him give a good account.

races.paceDynamic: Just A Gambler is the only genuine early pace in this field and will likely get an uncontested lead from the gates. With King Of Berkshire, Sudbury Hill, Yorkies Dream, Fairydale and Red Rifle all preferring to settle off the pace, Just A Gambler can dictate terms throughout the 1m2f trip. This creates a tactical scenario where the lone leader faces minimal early pressure, allowing him to control fractions and potentially steal the race if the hold-up brigade leave their runs too late. The race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader closely, as the wall of hold-up horses may struggle to make up ground if Just A Gambler gets away with soft fractions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Just A Gambler gets soft early fractions with no pressure from the field
scenarios.body: Just A Gambler controls the tempo completely and has enough left to resist the late challengers up the Redcar straight. The hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or Just A Gambler weakens significantly in the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: King Of Berkshire or Sudbury Hill time their runs perfectly to catch the tiring leader in the shadows of the post. The class and recent form of these hold-up specialists tells in a strongly-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If Just A Gambler sets honest but not demanding fractions throughout the middle stages
scenarios.body: The race becomes a genuine staying test where stamina and class prevail over tactics. Multiple horses arrive with chances in the final furlong creating a tight finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Just A Gambler goes very slowly early and the field bunches up approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish from the two-furlong pole with minimal early pace. Raw speed rather than stamina becomes the deciding factor in an unsatisfactory tactical affair.

watchPoints.text: Just A Gambler's early positioning will be crucial - if he breaks smartly and gets an easy lead, he becomes very dangerous with soft fractions.
King Of Berkshire's settling ability in the early stages, as any eagerness could compromise his devastating late kick shown at Yarmouth.
Sudbury Hill's fitness level returning from 41 days off, particularly in the final furlong where his stamina reserves will be tested.
The overall pace through the middle stages - if genuinely strong it plays to the hold-up horses, if modest it hands Just A Gambler a significant tactical edge.
Fairydale's jumping from the gates after 215 days off, as a slow start would make her hold-up task virtually impossible from this position.
